title: Talk:Guides
html:
12/13/2007 3:15 AM Submitted a few player guides here that I built that will help information seekers... suggestion to others: DO THE SAME!

If you dont mind I'll put it in a subcategory with the name External links. By the way, your guides are builds, not guides. Last thing is that the idea is that most of the information is within the wiki, I dont mind external links, but If you want specific builds on, you should make a build page under the Builds -> Untested PvE/PvP. Also this is not for advertising I hope, as that shouldnt be free, but I, for this time, will see it as more information for the player. --LegendRunner 16:22, 13 December 2007 (CET)
